original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳一男子在公交车上布道引发乘客不满
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据加纳媒体报道，一名男子在Kejetia登上trotro（当地小巴）后，手持圣经、以洪亮嗓音向乘客布道，声称要在车辆抵达Ejisu前拯救灵魂。报道称部分乘客本意是休息或打电话，一名疲惫女性只希望安静回家。该报道为单一来源，内容带有叙事色彩。

location.raw_text: a man boarded a trotro at Kejetia

key_facts.fact: 一名男子在Kejetia登上trotro后向乘客布道
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a man boarded a trotro at Kejetia with a Bible, a powerful voice and an urgent assignment from Heaven

key_facts.fact: 该男子称其任务是在车辆抵达Ejisu前拯救灵魂
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: His mission was to save souls before the vehicle reached Ejisu

key_facts.fact: 部分乘客对布道感到不满，有人想睡觉或打电话
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some wanted to sleep, others wanted to make telephone calls, and one exhausted woman simply wanted to reach home

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（MyJoyOnline）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
报道内容带有叙事/文学化色彩，具体细节未获独立确认
